mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an extreme monetary easing policy that compresses risk-free rates, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that typically precedes a decline in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 3% over the past month indicates a severe consumer sector contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < -5% and RSAFS < -3%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of negative industrial production growth (INDPRO < 0), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing weakness signals a deepening economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth < 0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The unemployment rate (UNRATE) has a consistent negative correlation with S&P 500 forward returns; higher unemployment rates predict negative 5-day returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.5%, it signals an extreme monetary easing environment that typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in the past month signals a weakening housing market that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < -5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth is negative and employment (PAYEMS) growth is negative, it signals a severe economic contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth < 0 and PAYEMS growth < 0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
